rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided Gardner 3AB label, but the image quality is limited and the response somewhat overstates visibility of a dense ICM and clear TE architecture that are not sharply discernible.

Integrates age, prior miscarriage, endometrial thickness, ovarian reserve, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality in a clinically meaningful way, though some links are stronger than others.

Overall structure is logical, but the quantitative probability adjustments appear somewhat arbitrary and there is some tension between calling AMH adequate and emphasizing DOR; miscarriage workup suggestions after a single loss are also a bit overstated.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, SET, and concern about thin endometrium, but recommendations such as routine freeze-all at 6 mm, endometrial scratch, ERA, DHEA/testosterone priming, and broad recurrent miscarriage/thrombophilia workup are not uniformly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next-step options for fresh transfer versus freeze-all and future cycle planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
